race.comment: YOURE NOT THE KING (4) lightly raced gelding who made a big impression in his first campaign. Won on debut at the Sunshine Coast and ended up finishing seventh in the LR Daybreak Lover over 1400m at Eagle Farm last April. Now in the Bjorn Baker yard and looks primed for a first-up victory. BENGAL (2) is holding his own in Highway class and due for a change of luck. Motored late in a solid rating contest when fourth over 1000m at Randwick. Extra trip in his favour with the fitness edge. MASTER YODA (8) lightly raced gelding resuming. Built a tidy record in the first prep with the two wins and has been thereabouts in the two trials. VIIPURI (10) resumes. Zac Lloyd takes the reins after he went out a winner when getting up in a tight finish over 1300m Goulburn in C2 class last May. Back with the two solid trials and can overcome the wide draw.
